explanation: The new mean is (280 + 900) / 8 = €147.50, more than €100 higher. The median of 8 values is the average of the 4th and 5th sorted values, (35 + 40) / 2 = €37.50, only €2.50 higher. One large value moves the mean a lot and the median hardly at all, which is why the median describes a typical order in skewed data.
